lines.zh: 我贴着地面走，翅膀半开。
lines.en: I walk low with my wings half spread.
My red scales brush the grass.
I come at you with my back arched.

lines.zh: 我弓着背，一步步缩短距离。
lines.en: Back arched, I eat up the distance step by step.

lines.zh: 尾巴扫着草，我跟在后面。
lines.en: My tail sweeps the grass as I come on.

lines.zh: 我踩得地面一下一下响。
lines.en: The ground thumps with each step.

lines.zh: 我直线过来，石头挡不住。
lines.en: I come straight in; the rocks won't stop me.
I walk straight at you.

lines.zh: 我的爪子收着，还没伸出来。
lines.en: My claws are sheathed for now.
I come within a few paces.

lines.zh: 喉音压得很低，我朝你来。
lines.en: A low rumble in my throat as I come.
I take one more long stride.
I stand, my scales flexing.

lines.zh: 我从龙之手的遗迹里出来的。
lines.en: I came from the ruins of the Drakvyrn Hand.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀张开一半，像在量你。
lines.en: My wings half open, as if measuring you.
I stare at the edge of your shadow.

lines.zh: 我在等一个先动的动作。
lines.en: I'm waiting for the first move.
I lick the tips of my teeth; sharp.

lines.zh: 我侧耳听林子里那点动静。
lines.en: I tilt an ear toward the stir in the trees.
The air here is a little warm.

lines.zh: 我的爪尖在地上划了一下。
lines.en: A claw scores the ground once.
The red on me deepens.
I never need an excuse to strike.

lines.zh: 红鳞一抖，我换了个朝向。
lines.en: A shake of red scales; I turn to a new angle.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀一收，草被压下去。
lines.en: My wings fold and the grass flattens.
The moment your steps falter, I move.
You're standing right in front of me.
I lower my head at you.
You shouldn't have touched that egg.
These scales aren't for show.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛一直没有离开你。
lines.en: My eyes haven't left you.

lines.zh: 你退开一步，我就停一下。
lines.en: One step back and I pause.

lines.zh: 翅膀撑到最大，我压低喉咙。
lines.en: Wings at full spread, I drop my growl low.
Where are your hands.

lines.zh: 我要看看你带没带武器。
lines.en: I want to see if you're armed.
I don't roar; I bite.

lines.zh: 你的气味我没在巢边闻过。
lines.en: I've never smelled you near my nest.
My claws are out.
I give a step and my scales flare.
That found a gap in my scales.
I growl, low in my chest.
I tuck my wings against my flanks.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在土里抓出痕。
lines.en: My claws gouge the soil.
I sway and steady.
Blood seeps from under my scales.
I give half a step, still watching you.
I crouch lower without a sound.

lines.zh: 血顺着鳞往下，我还没退。
lines.en: Blood runs down my scales; I haven't backed off.
I don't eat this; I bite what lives.
You hold it up and I give it two looks.

lines.zh: 我一口就能咬断你的手。
lines.en: I could take your hand off in one bite.
A dead thing like that; I won't open my mouth.
I swat it aside.

lines.zh: 你手上那点东西换不来什么。
lines.en: That won't buy you anything.
I'm not some wild dog.
The smell is far too faint.
I sniff once and turn away.

lines.zh: 拿开，别挡着你自己的脸。
lines.en: Move it; it's blocking your face.

lines.zh: 你撞上我，我的鳞片响了。
lines.en: You hit me and my scales ring.
I give a step and come right back.

lines.zh: 这一下让我的翅膀歪了。
lines.en: That knocks my wing crooked.

lines.zh: 我侧过身，你擦着过去了。
lines.en: I turn my flank and you graze past.
I butt your shoulder.

lines.zh: 尘土在我们中间翻起来。
lines.en: Dust rolls between us.
I'm steady again in a moment.
You're stronger than you look.
One lash of my tail and sand flies.
I don't retreat far.
She's red-scaled too.

lines.zh: 她把头抵在我的脖子上。
lines.en: She presses her head against my neck.
Our wings touch.

lines.zh: 她的翅尖扫过我的脖子。
lines.en: Her wingtip brushes my neck.
We walk the same circle.
She doesn't call out; neither do I.

lines.zh: 我们一起把翅膀收起来。
lines.en: We fold our wings together.

lines.zh: 她把尾巴搭在我的上面。
lines.en: She lays her tail over mine.

lines.zh: 我们两副红鳞，挤在树影里。
lines.en: Two sets of red scales, crowded in the shade.
She walks into the tree's shadow.
My jaws close, and I lift it.
My jaws close, and it snaps in two.

lines.zh: 我一咬就碎，渣掉了一地。
lines.en: One bite and it crumbles, bits everywhere.
I spit it onto the ground.
I pin it with a claw.

lines.zh: 这点东西不值得我低头。
lines.en: This isn't worth lowering my head.
I fling it behind the trees.

lines.zh: 牙缝里卡着东西，我甩头。
lines.en: Something's stuck in my teeth; I shake my head.
Something's on my muzzle; I wipe it away.

lines.zh: 我爪子一摁，它陷进土里。
lines.en: One press of my claw, and it sinks into the dirt.

lines.zh: 你一抬脚，我的耐性就完了。
lines.en: One lift of your foot ends my patience.
I lower my head and spread my wings.
I drop low and launch myself.
This is the edge of my nest.

lines.zh: 你的位置，已经刻在我眼里。
lines.en: Your place is fixed in my eyes.
I start speeding up by degrees.
There are trees behind you.
All my claws are out.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙里那声终于出来了。
lines.en: The sound in my throat finally comes out.

lines.zh: 我的牙已经对准你的肩。
lines.en: My teeth are already lined up on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你退得越快我追得越急。
lines.en: The faster you flee, the harder I chase.
A few strides and I'm there.

lines.zh: 你脚下一滑，我立刻扑上去。
lines.en: Your foot slips, and I lunge at once.

lines.zh: 爪子离地，我朝着你去了。
lines.en: Claws off the ground, I'm coming for you.

lines.zh: 我跟着你，每一步都很近。
lines.en: I follow you, every step close.

lines.zh: 矮木丛挡道，我一头顶开。
lines.en: A low thicket bars the way; I butt it open.
You turn; I cut across.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀让我跳得更远。
lines.en: My wings carry me farther.
The ground jumps when I land.

lines.zh: 你喘得越急，我追得越紧。
lines.en: The harder you breathe, the closer I come.

lines.zh: 你站住，我绕着圈子等你露空。
lines.en: You stand still; I circle, waiting for a gap.
I crouch, ready to spring.
There's open ground ahead of you.
I leap across that open ground.
You turn to face me.
You raise your weapon; that's what I want.

lines.zh: 我的嘴张得能塞下你的头。
lines.en: My jaws open wide enough for your head.

lines.zh: 你把铁举高，我先看手腕。
lines.en: You raise the iron; I watch your wrist.

lines.zh: 你背后是石壁，我封了退路。
lines.en: The stone wall's at your back; I've cut off your retreat.
I lunge and bite your shoulder.
One claw sweeps across.

lines.zh: 我爪子落下，你的护肩裂了。
lines.en: My claws come down; your pauldron splits.
You strike my scales and skid off.
My teeth catch cloth; I haul back.
The second bite goes deeper than the first.
My teeth sink in.

lines.zh: 你退开，我翅膀一扇追上。
lines.en: You back off; one beat of my wings follows.
One claw pins you flat.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴带着风，扫你膝弯。
lines.en: My tail whips the air at the back of your knee.
That bite closes on empty air.
I turn and lunge once more.
The smell of blood is up; I press harder.
I slowly let go.

lines.zh: 我从遗迹的阴影里出来。
lines.en: I come out of the ruin's shadow.
Soil still clings to my scales.
I spread my wings and fold them.

lines.zh: 这气味很新，我闻出是活物。
lines.en: The smell is fresh; I can tell it's alive.
I lower my head and test my bite.
This is the edge of my nest.
I walk toward that smell.

lines.zh: 我的爪子在地上留下痕。
lines.en: My claws leave marks.
I open my mouth and call for the first time.
One roar from me and the birds scatter.

lines.zh: 头贴着地，我等一个破绽。
lines.en: Head low, I wait for one opening.

lines.zh: 这片林子没有能拦我的。
lines.en: Nothing in these woods can hold me.
I know this ground.
No more waiting; I set off.

lines.zh: 别想从那个蛋里拿走什么。
lines.en: Don't think you'll take anything from that egg.
I'm coming over your way.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的翅膀，我甩开了。
lines.en: Fire licks my wing and I shake it off.

lines.zh: 我从高处摔下来，鳞片响了。
lines.en: I fall from a height and my scales ring.

lines.zh: 水没到脖子，我蹬着往上。
lines.en: Water's at my throat; I kick upward.
The blast throws me into the brush.

lines.zh: 一根尖物扎进我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something sharp lodges in my wing.
The light makes my scales burn.
Too long hungry; my claws tremble.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的鳞走，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my scales and I shudder.

lines.zh: 脚下没有东西，我一直在掉。
lines.en: Nothing under me; I keep falling.
